context7.description: Context7 MCP server for Angular and Playwright documentation

usage.architect: Query Angular architecture patterns and best practices
usage.ux-dev: Lookup component APIs, design patterns, accessibility guidelines

playwright.description: Playwright MCP server for E2E testing and visual regression

usage.tester: Execute E2E tests, visual regression, accessibility validation
usage.ux-dev: Validate component interactions and visual behavior

github.description: GitHub MCP server for issue and PR management

usage.architect: Update issues with designs, create PRs for ADRs
usage.ux-dev: Create implementation PRs, update issue status

filesystem.description: FileSystem MCP server for codebase access

usage.architect: Analyze existing code structure and patterns
usage.ux-dev: Read design tokens, check existing components
usage.issue-creator: Parse requirement files, analyze codebase for context

setup: 1. Install required MCP servers: npm install -g @context7/mcp-server @playwright/mcp-server @modelcontextprotocol/server-github @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
2. Set GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable with GitHub Personal Access Token
3. Ensure Node.js and npm are installed
4. Verify Playwright browsers are installed: npx playwright install
usage: Agents will automatically connect to their designated MCP servers
Context7 requires internet connection for documentation queries
GitHub MCP requires valid authentication token
FileSystem MCP is restricted to project directory only
